lesson.grammar_point: present simple negative (don't / doesn't) with like and love
phases: The Only English You Already Have
I Do Not, He Does Not

listenings.text: Good evening, and welcome to the rock hour. Tonight we play three classic bands. The first song is from the seventies, and the singer does not sing it slowly. The second band is from England. They do not play on the radio very often, but people love them. The last song is a request from a listener in Brazil. Thank you for listening, and have a good night.

Hi Ricardo. This is Diane. You said you like rock, and I like rock too. My son does not like rock; he likes rap. My favorite band is from the eighties. I do not know the lyrics of all the songs, but I sing them anyway in the car. Here is an idea: send me one song you like, and I send you one. We can talk about them on Friday. Bye.

extra_audio.text: I listen to a rock song one time. I do not read anything. Then I read the lyrics in English. I look for the words I know. Finally I open the translator.
